description: Maps Makerkit MCP tool clusters to authorized agent roles. Roster.json#mcp_tools references cluster names from this file.

project_status.name: Project status & health
project_status.purpose: Read-only inspection of kit project state, prerequisites, and improvement opportunities. Safe for any role to call as a no-op pre-flight.
project_status.notes: Run kit_prerequisites + kit_status FIRST in any workflow's Phase 0. get_improvement_suggestions seeds the PM's ISC list with framework-aware ideas.

dev_server.name: Dev server lifecycle
dev_server.purpose: Start, stop, and inspect the kit's local dev server. Required for browser-based repro and E2E.
dev_server.notes: Always check kit_dev_status before kit_dev_start to avoid double-starting. kit_dev_stop in finally-block when a workflow started it.

database.name: Prisma schema, migrations, queries
database.purpose: Inspect schema, generate/apply migrations, seed/reset DB, search functions. Full DB lifecycle.
database.notes: Phase 3 (Schema) is the natural home. kit_db_reset is destructive — operator approval before any role calls it. Architect uses get_database_summary for placement decisions; Backend uses get_table_info / search_database_functions for query design; Database role owns generate_migration / apply_migrations.

components.name: @kit/ui component catalog
components.purpose: Discover and read existing components before reinventing. Read-only.
components.notes: MUST be called by Frontend/UI before authoring a new component — duplication-prevention. Use components_search with feature keywords first; get_component_content + get_component_props for the candidates.

checks.name: Healthcheck scripts and run_checks
checks.purpose: Run the kit's defined check scripts (typecheck, lint, format, test). MUST in verification phases.
checks.notes: run_checks is the canonical 'is the codebase healthy?' tool. Verification workflows (CodeReview, TestAndValidate, BugFix Phase 4, Refactor Phase 4) MUST invoke it. get_scripts enumerates available checks; get_script_details shows what a script actually runs.

env.name: Environment variables and schema
env.purpose: Read/write env files; inspect env schema. Sensitive — handle carefully.
env.notes: kit_env_raw_* bypasses validation — DevOps only. Security audits use kit_env_schema (read-only) to verify env-var hygiene. Backend uses kit_env_read for what's available; updates go through kit_env_update with schema validation.

email.name: Email mailbox (mailpit) and templates
email.purpose: Inspect sent emails, read templates, mark messages read. E2E and TestAndValidate use this for assertion + drift checks.
email.notes: FrameworkDigest §10 mailpit assertion patterns — E2E reaches for kit_emails_list + kit_emails_read instead of the older HTTP-fetch pattern. kit_mailbox_status verifies mailpit is up before assertions.

translations.name: i18n / next-intl translations
translations.purpose: Manage locales, namespaces, and translation keys. Coverage stats catch i18n drift early.
translations.notes: Frontend uses kit_translations_update + kit_translations_add_namespace when wiring i18n keys for a new feature. TestAndValidate / DocsRefresh use kit_translations_stats to detect missing-key drift across locales. remove_locale / remove_namespace are destructive — operator gate.

prds_stories.name: Makerkit PRDs and user stories
prds_stories.purpose: OPTIONAL surface — kit-native PRD/story system. DOS PRD ledger is canonical; this is a mirror surface for kit projects that maintain Makerkit-native PRDs.
prds_stories.notes: DO NOT replace the DOS PRD ledger with create_prd — DOS PRD at MEMORY/WORK/{slug}/PRD.md is system of record. PM role MAY mirror to kit-native PRD when the kit project independently uses this surface. add_user_story is the natural fit for PM Phase 1 if the kit-native flow is in use; otherwise PM drafts user stories directly in the DOS PRD's ## Context.

deps.name: Dependency upgrade advisor
deps.purpose: Suggest dependency upgrades with risk/benefit analysis.
deps.notes: DevOps periodic; SecurityAudit when scope includes 'are deps current'.
